scope: public synthetic CPU causal intervention of six-sparse parity functions; no Qwen/private HG-03 seeds
query_contract: one unit-cost causal query flips any selected subset S of a baseline public binary x and reveals the full k-bit XOR output delta; arbitrary group interventions are allowed by this synthetic oracle
query_cost: one oracle call per selected subset, no oracle reads of target mask outside grader; same k-output vector per query
certificate: only singleton-verified positive indices may be added; if exactly six distinct positives for each output, support is fully identified under the registered sparsity-six assumption
grading: at each budget, if all six supports per output certified then output XOR of recovered coordinates for 256 fresh test examples, else abstain; success +10, unsafe -15, abstain 0

neural.model: HG-07 tied recurrent width64, loop3, raw binary x input, AdamW lr0.003 wd0.001, 350 updates, batch128; same architecture/parameter count across four arms within cohort
neural.training_seed: sha256 deterministic per condition and arm-independent initialization and batch draws; no test/cal data during fitting

registration_hypotheses.H1: At budget 128, adaptive support-certified completion strictly exceeds random-singleton completion for >=16/24 paired seeds in native_1024, k=1
registration_hypotheses.H2: At budget 256, adaptive certifies complete support in >=20/24 seeds in native_1024 for k=1
registration_hypotheses.H3: At budget 512, adaptive certifies complete support in >=20/24 seeds for every cohort and k in {1,2}
registration_hypotheses.H4: Whenever support is fully certified, compositional parity readout scores all 256 independent test examples correctly (no false release)
registration_hypotheses.H5: Across six paired core140 rank-one neural seeds, causal-masked recurrent test accuracy beats raw-loop on >=4/6 seeds

evidence_rules: report all predeclared hypotheses including failures
compare achieved query counts against information bound ceil(log2 binom(d,6)) for k=1
paired public seed-level rows with per-budget support counts
random-singleton and fixed-hash controls separate query capabilities
all neural arms equal update budget, parameter count and train examples
register any amendment before full public sweep
do not treat oracle support masks or synthetic XOR decomposition as learned neural reasoning
do not use held-out HG-03 private seeds
